sentences.text:
Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Writ Petition No.22001 Of 2024
Order:

Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Municipal Administration & Urban Development appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1, 3 and 4, Sri B.
Jagan Madhav Rao, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of respondent No.2 and with the consent of parties, the Writ Petition is taken up for hearing and disposal at the stage of admission.

2. Petitioner contends that the 2nd respondent authority is trying to lay a sewerage pipeline in petitioner's land, without following due process of law by initiating proceedings under The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 and without payment of compensation, as being illegal and arbitrary.
3.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Written instructions under the signature of respondent No.2 authority is placed before this Court.

4. By the written instructions, it is stated that the 2nd respondent is nowhere concerned with the laying of the sewerage pipeline in petitioner's land in Sy. Nos.37, 38, 39 and 40 of Pocharam village,
Ghatkeswar Mandal, Medchal-Malkajgiri District.

5. By the Written instructions, it is further stated that in respect of the subject land there is a dispute between the petitioner and the revenue authorities and that the petitioner without filing any document relating to his property has filed the present Writ Petition making omnibus allegations against the 2nd respondent.
6. I have taken note of the respective contentions urged.

7. While it is the contention of the petitioner that the respondent authorities are laying pipeline through the petitioner's land in Sy. Nos.37, 38, 39 and 40 of of Pocharam village, Ghatkeswar Mandal, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, without following due process of law, as the 2nd respondent by the written instructions, having categorically stated that the said respondent is nowhere concerned about the laying of the sewerage pipeline in the petitioner's land, this Court is of the view that the aforesaid statement made to this Court by the 2nd respondent can be taken on record.

8. Further, it is also to be noted that mere existence of a dispute in respect of the subject land M. Yadagiri Reddy vs State Of Telangana on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144826217/
1 between the petitioner and the revenue authorities would not by itself confer any right on the 2nd respondent authorities even otherwise to lay a pipeline without following due process of law.

entities.text: M. Yadagiri Reddy vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. Having regard to the aforesaid submissions made and also taking note of the statement made to this Court by the 2nd respondent by the written instructions which is taken on record, this Court is of the view that the grievance of the petitioner in the present Writ Petition stands redressed and the 2nd respondent authority is hereby directed to abide by the statement made to this Court under the written instructions.
10. Subject to the above observation, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
Consequently, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
